data.name: Real or Fake?
data.description: An AI-image detector tested across six real-world transformations, with an interactive human-versus-AI game. I built the model, evaluation pipeline, inference API, and web experience.
data.note: Project evaluation: 0.9578 clean / 0.8966 robust ROC-AUC on an 800-image diagnostic pool.

data.name: Carrie
data.description: A prototype AI wellbeing companion with live voice interaction and facial-expression signals. I developed the AI and Python components that connect visual context to the conversation.
data.note: A hackathon wellbeing prototype, not a clinical care service.

data.name: CoverCheck SG
data.description: An insurance-readiness prototype with a guided user journey, deterministic comparisons, and evidence-grounded explanations. I built the core frontend and API workflows and integrated retrieval, Bedrock explanations, and confirmed profile changes.
data.note: Synthetic plan comparisons; cached real-product brochures supply supporting context.

data.name: ClinicPrep Assistant
data.description: A pre-visit clinic-registration prototype. I built the core Copilot Studio conversation flows and a live Power Automate / SharePoint handoff so staff receive a structured summary for review.
data.note: Eligibility and billing use mocks. Staff retain identity and insurance-card checks.

data.name: MCP ToolBox
data.description: Tools that help an AI agent retrieve study material, plan routes, find venues, and coordinate schedules. I built the Node.js MCP implementation and refined retrieval ranking and tool behaviour across challenge stages.
